gift.body: A voucher for a 30-minute taster or a full day rental. Valid 12 months.

age.q: How old do I need to be?
age.a: Minimum age is 14 (with parental consent), no upper limit. Our oldest riders are 65+.

experience.a: No. 90 % of our guests start from zero. A short intro takes ~15 minutes and covers everything you need.

weather.a: You can reschedule free of charge up to 12 hours before. In a storm or strong wind we'll suggest another slot.

gear.a: Swimwear, towel, sunscreen. Everything else (board, helmet, vest, wetsuit) is included.

weight.a: The board works for riders from 40 to 110 kg.

pickup.q: How does pickup and return work?
pickup.a: By arrangement — at our base on Green Lake or in one of the partner cities (Maribor, Ljubljana, Celje). At pickup we walk you through the gear, battery charging and safety procedures. Return is the same.

cities.q: Which cities do you cover for pickup?
cities.a: Free pickup in Maribor, Ljubljana and Celje. For other Slovenian cities we can arrange delivery for a fee — email info@surf-store.com.

ownSpot.q: Can I take the board to my own lake or to the sea?
ownSpot.a: Yes — e-foil is allowed on most Slovenian lakes (check local rules — some protected areas need a permit). At sea you need a standard navigation permit, the same one already needed for WIN/SUP.

deposit.a: For multi-day rentals (3+ days) we ask for a €500 deposit in cash or by card. It's returned right after we check the equipment back in, if there's no visible damage.

charging.q: How do I charge the battery?
charging.a: With the included charger from any standard 220 V outlet. A full charge takes about 1 hour. You have two batteries — use one while the other charges.

transport.q: What car do I need to transport it?
transport.a: The Duotone Foil Cruise set is roughly 1.75 m long. Fits in most vans, SUVs and estate cars with folded seats. For sedans we recommend a roof rack or a small trailer.

damage.q: What happens if something gets damaged?
damage.a: Minor damage (scratches on the board) is covered by the deposit. Larger damage (broken foil, motor or battery) is charged at Duotone service rates. We recommend filming a short condition check before you go on the water.

cancel.a: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before. 48–24 hours: half price. Less than 24 h: full price. Weather-related reschedules are free.

hero.title: E-FOIL
hero.subtitle: An electric board with a hydrofoil wing — the newest watersport that silently lifts you above the surface.

what.title: WHAT IS AN E-FOIL?
what.lead: An e-foil (short for "electric hydrofoil") is a modern board with an electric motor and an underwater wing (the foil) that lifts the entire board above the surface once it reaches a certain speed. You ride one meter above the water, with no wave contact and almost no drag.
what.p1: Riders control it with a wireless hand-held trigger that regulates motor power. The battery is built into the board and the motor sits at the bottom of the hydrofoil mast — submerged, directly under the board.
what.p2: Unlike traditional surfing, sail foiling or wakeboarding, an e-foil needs no waves, no wind, and no tow boat. All you need is a charged battery and calm water — a lake, the sea, or a wide river.

how.title: HOW AN E-FOIL WORKS
how.subtitle: Four components that together create the sensation of flight:

board.title: The board
board.body: Carbon or EPS construction with a track system for quick foil mounting. 35–110 L volume depending on rider weight.

foil.title: The hydrofoil
foil.body: An underwater wing. Once the board moves fast enough, the wing generates lift and raises the entire setup into the air.

motor.title: Motor + propeller
motor.body: A brushless electric motor (typically 4–10 kW) with a shrouded propeller, mounted at the top of the foil just under the board.

battery.title: Battery + trigger
battery.body: A Li-ion battery in the board powers the motor. A wireless trigger in your hand controls speed — seven or more power steps.

why.title: WHY HAS E-FOILING BECOME SO POPULAR?

silent.title: Almost silent
silent.body: The electric motor is whisper-quiet — riders only hear the water. Perfect for lakes, protected areas and early-morning sessions.

noWaves.title: No waves needed
noWaves.body: No waves, wind or tow boat required. Calm water is enough — fly whenever and wherever you want.

clean.title: Zero emissions
clean.body: 100 % electric. No fuel, no oil, no exhaust. Eco-friendly and permitted on protected lakes.

learn.title: Quick to learn
learn.body: Most beginners are flying within 30–60 minutes. The trigger has a programmed power curve that makes the first lift-off easy.

range.title: Up to 2-hour range
range.body: A full battery lasts 30–90 minutes of intense riding, or up to 2 hours of relaxed cruising.

ages.title: All ages
ages.body: Suitable from age 14 (with parental consent) onwards — no upper limit. We've taught riders over 60 without issue.

forWhom.title: WHO IS IT FOR?
forWhom.p1: Beginners who want the feeling of surfing without waiting for waves or expensive lessons. After a 30-minute brief and an hour on the water, most people are already flying.
forWhom.p2: Experienced watersport people (kiters, wingfoilers, surfers) looking for a new discipline — a completely different feel for water and the freedom to ride even when conditions aren't there.
forWhom.p3: Families and groups looking for a water activity where every participant — from teenager to grandparent — can learn in the same day.
forWhom.p4: Hospitality and event professionals using it as a premium guest experience.

learning.title: YOUR FIRST DAY ON AN E-FOIL
learning.subtitle: A typical first hour with our instructor at Green Lake, Kidričevo:

s1.title: Briefing on shore
s1.body: Equipment walkthrough, safety, controls. How the foil works and what to expect on lift-off.

s2.title: On the knees
s2.body: We start on the belly, then on the knees. Get a feel for the trigger and balance before any lift-off.

s3.title: Standing
s3.body: Stand up on the board. Ride straight on the surface, no foil action yet.

s4.title: First lift-off ⚡
s4.body: Right weight + enough speed = the foil lifts you. The unforgettable first flight above water.

learning.tip: Nearly 90 % of our guests are flying within the first hour. A few need another 30 minutes — that's completely normal.

hero.title: DUOTONE FOIL
hero.intro: Duotone is a premium watersports brand under the Boards & More group from Germany. From kitesurfing to wing-foiling and now e-foiling, Duotone builds gear that's both high-performance and approachable. Every product is co-developed with world champions — Sky Solbach, Jake Kelsick, Matchu Lopes — and tested in Hawaiian and European waters.

story.title: THE SHORT STORY
story.p1: Duotone split from North Kiteboarding in 2018 to become a standalone brand inside the Boards & More group. It quickly built one of the largest wing-foil ranges in the world — from the first wings to complete foil packages.
story.p2: With e-foil, Duotone brings electric assist into the same modular system its wing-foil team rides. Same masts, same front wings, same boards — just add the e-harness and batteries.
story.p3: The philosophy: one modular platform for every foil discipline. Less gear, more time on the water.

range.title: DUOTONE FOIL RANGE
range.subtitle: Three build tiers — from absolute top-end to everyday workhorse.

dlab.name: D/LAB Carbon
dlab.desc: The lightest build — full carbon, lowest mass, fastest response. For pros and racers.

al.name: Foil Assist AL
al.desc: Our rental setup. Aluminum mast, rugged and reliable for daily use.

cruise.name: Cruise Mast AL
cruise.desc: Shorter 80 cm mast for easier learning and shallow water. Ideal for beginners and family rides.

tech.title: ONE MODULAR SYSTEM
tech.p1: Every Duotone foil set shares the same track system — masts, fuselages, front and back wings swap in seconds, no tools.
tech.p2: Meaning: if you already own a Duotone wing-foil, you only need to add the eHarness + batteries to go electric. One kit, two disciplines.
